content.comment_body: Could someone provide the VM addresses used for the softkey block when working with an HMI? Thanks

There isn't a VM address available for the softkey block. This feature can only be utilized in the [product_name] or with the [product_name] display. Edit: With the HMI, the softkey block isn't necessary. You can create custom buttons or switches within the HMI itself.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is asking how to use softkey blocks with an HMI, specifically about the required VM addresses. The response clarifies that softkey blocks do not have VM addresses, and for HMI integration, you can simply design your own button functionality within the HMI software. This points to some confusion about how features map between PLC and HMI environments.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that softkey blocks will have assignable VM addresses for integration with an HMI and is seeking confirmation or guidance on how to achieve this.
